verses.en: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
verses.pt: Vinde, e tornemos para o Senhor, porque ele despedaçou e nos sarará; fez a ferida, e no-la atará.
verses.en_web: “Come, and let us return to Yahweh; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.
verses.en_bbe: Come, let us go back to the Lord; for he has given us wounds and he will make us well; he has given blows and he will give help.

verses.en: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
verses.pt: Depois de dois dias nos ressuscitará: ao terceiro dia nos levantará, e viveremos diante dele.
verses.en_web: After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him.
verses.en_bbe: After two days he will give us life, and on the third day he will make us get up, and we will be living before him.

verses.en: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
verses.pt: Conheçamos, e prossigamos em conhecer ao Senhor; a sua saída, como a alva, é certa; e ele a nós virá como a chuva, como a chuva serôdia que rega a terra.
verses.en_web: Let us acknowledge Yahweh. Let us press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: And let us have knowledge, let us go after the knowledge of the Lord; his going out is certain as the dawn, his decisions go out like the light; he will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain watering the earth.

verses.en: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
verses.pt: Que te farei, ó Efraim? que te farei, ó Judá? porque o vosso amor é como a nuvem da manhã, e como o orvalho que cedo passa.
verses.en_web: “Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew that disappears early.
verses.en_bbe: O Ephraim, what am I to do to you? O Judah, what am I to do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew which goes early away.

verses.en: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth.
verses.pt: Por isso os abati pelos profetas; pela palavra da minha boca os matei; e os meus juízos a teu respeito sairão como a luz.
verses.en_web: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are like a flash of lightning.
verses.en_bbe: So I have had it cut in stones; I gave them teaching by the words of my mouth;

verses.en: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
verses.pt: Pois misericórdia quero, e não sacrifícios; e o conhecimento de Deus, mais do que os holocaustos.
verses.en_web: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
verses.en_bbe: Because my desire is for mercy and not offerings; for the knowledge of God more than for burned offerings.

verses.en: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
verses.pt: Eles, porém, como Adão, transgrediram o pacto; nisso eles se portaram aleivosamente contra mim.
verses.en_web: But they, like Adam, have broken the covenant. They were unfaithful to me, there.
verses.en_bbe: But like a man, they have gone against the agreement; there they were false to me.

verses.en: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.
verses.pt: Gileade é cidade de malfeitores, está manchada de sangue.
verses.en_web: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.
verses.en_bbe: Gilead is a town of evil-doers, marked with blood.

verses.en: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
verses.pt: Como hordas de salteadores que espreitam alguém, assim é a companhia dos sacerdotes que matam no caminho para Siquém; sim, cometem a vilania.
verses.en_web: As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a man, so the company of priests murder on the path toward Shechem, committing shameful crimes.
verses.en_bbe: And like a band of thieves waiting for a man, so are the priests watching secretly the way of those going quickly to Shechem, for they are working with an evil design.

verses.en: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
verses.pt: Vejo uma coisa horrenda na casa de Israel; ali está a prostituição de Efraim; Israel está contaminado.
verses.en_web: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing. There is prostitution in Ephraim. Israel is defiled.
verses.en_bbe: In Israel I have seen a very evil thing; there false ways are seen in Ephraim, Israel is unclean;

verses.en: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
verses.pt: Também para ti, ó Judá, está determinada uma ceifa. Ao querer eu trazer do cativeiro o meu povo,
verses.en_web: “Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people.
verses.en_bbe: And Judah has put up disgusting images for himself.
